brief:
Former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak characterized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as "a wounded animal in a trap," the Maan Wire reported. Barak's comments came amid escalating political tensions within Israel as Netanyahu confronts mounting legal pressures and political opposition.

The sharp rebuke reflects the depth of divisions among Israeli leadership over the direction of governance and strategy. Barak, who previously served as defense minister and prime minister, has emerged as a vocal critic of the current government during the ongoing conflict.
title: Barak calls Netanyahu a wounded animal in a trap
